desc: Ideation: reduce p = A*B*C, require ordered disjoint occurrences end(A)<=start(B)<=end(B)<=start(C), minimize span.
Implement Solution with KMP occurrence lists (overlap-aware) for A, B, C and two-pointer minimization over B occ (and over C occ when B empty).
Handle empty A/B/C, single-nonempty-literal cases, p="**" -> 0, and no-match -> -1.
Execute the four provided examples plus edge cases and a 1e5 performance check; sample verdict PASS (8, -1, 0, 6), edges PASS, stress vs brute force PASS, timing OK.
